_comment: shape: single (target point), line (3 tiles ahead), cone (3 wide, 2.5 deep), ring (radius 2 around the user), self. vfx family: burst | projectile | beam | ring | cloud, tinted by the move's type colour and scaled by size. anim: the SpriteCollab action the attacker plays. strip (optional): a hand-made sprite strip under assets/vfx/ that replaces the procedural family. cooldown and cast in seconds.
_fx: fx: Guardian Signs effects (assets/fx/guardian_signs/<id>.png) played when the move resolves. anchor: attacker (on the user; mode beam tiles the strip from user to target, stream stretches it), projectile (flies user -> target; the target parts after it play on arrival; arc lobs it), sky (falls onto each target from `height` tiles up), target (on each Pokemon hit, at the middle of its body, scaled gently with its size). mode status loops above the head. ground: drawn flat under the Pokemon (rings, puddles, cracks). delay: seconds before the part starts. fps default 15, scale default 2 (pixels per source pixel at the normal zoom), tint optional. shake: screen shake on heavy hits (0..1). One idea per move: a wind-up or carrier, one impact, at most one aftershock.
